card.name: Words just before a result number
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or the first digit right before a reported figure or finding in clinical-trial or survey results, such as 'incidence of', 'was', or 'about 3'.

modes.description: A verb or linking word that leads into an observed outcome in an overdose or reaction report.
